hook.text: JetUP's latest start promo works like this.

dep.text: You deposit one hundred and fifty five dollars.

fifty.text: Fifty goes into the Sonic strategy.

hundred.text: One hundred stays in your balance for the Dennis Promo, which adds another one hundred.

claim.text: Claim the Dennis Fast Start Promo.

cu.text: In TAG Markets, open the menu, tap Profile, and write down your C U number.

tile.text: Go to jet dash up dot A I, and tap the orange Dennis Fast Start Promo tile.

form.text: Enter your name, email and C U number exactly, and tap Join the promo.

mail.text: When the confirmation email arrives, open Copy X, then Follower Hub, then Strategies.

two.text: You'll see two Sonic accounts: your fifty dollar account, and your two hundred dollar promo account.

anytime.text: Profits can be withdrawn any time.

bonus.text: The one hundred dollar bonus is released after twelve months.

ends.text: And taking your own money out before then ends the promo.

change.text: Rules can change, so check your dashboard.

promo.text: And remember: a promo is a promo.

start.text: So if you've decided to start, start while it's still on, and confirm it on jet dash up dot A I before you deposit.

hi.text: Hi, I'm MTG, Your Digital Architect.

n_turn2.text: Simple, right? Now it's your turn.

l_ifme.text: If I invited you, go to MTG tribe dot com slash jet up, and tap any Join Jet Up button.

every.text: Invited by someone else? Use their link. This video is for every team, so feel free to share it.

o_fin.text: Quick reminder: none of this is financial advice.

o_thanks.text: Thank you for tuning in, and for every like, share, and comment.

o_massive.text: And thank yourself for taking massive action today to change your future!

o_best.text: I wish you nothing but the best, because YOU are the best.

o_see.text: See you on the next one.

n_save.text: Save this video, so it's here when you need it.

n_share.text: Share it with someone who's ready to start.

n_we.text: We learn best when we teach others.

n_slog.text: It pays to pay attention, and take action.
